features.name: Android WYSIWYG Markdown Editor
features.description: Replace the read-only MarkdownPreview toggle in EditorScreen.kt with an editable WYSIWYG editor (richeditor-compose RichTextEditor) in eye mode, keeping BasicTextField+SyntaxHighlightTransformation as the raw/pencil mode. contentField.text stays the single source of truth (markdown), synced bidirectionally via setMarkdown()/toMarkdown().
features.evidence: FINAL ARCHITECTURE (after two reverted attempts: richeditor-compose AST round-trip reformatted untouched content; BasicTextField VisualTransformation never rendered anything in this Compose version). Split editor/preview: eye icon = BasicTextField + SyntaxHighlightTransformation (raw editable markdown, zero reformatting risk); pencil icon = MarkdownPreview (apps/android/ui/components), a read-only real Compose UI render built from shared/core's MarkdownParser AST (headings at Material3 sizes, code blocks with surfaceVariant background, blockquotes with drawBehind border, lists with markers/indentation, inline bold/italic/strikethrough/code/links). No external dependency, no sync logic. Verified: compileDebugKotlin, full init.sh, shared/core tests all green. Pushed to main (3039a17).

features.name: Block-Level Copy for Markdown Preview
features.description: Each rendered block in MarkdownPreview (heading, paragraph, code block, blockquote, list item) gets its own copy button/long-press action that copies just that block's raw markdown to the clipboard, reconstructed via a new MarkdownSerializer (shared/core).
features.evidence: Added MarkdownSerializer.kt (shared/core/markdown) converting MdBlock/MdInline back to markdown text — used only to produce a fresh clipboard string for an explicit user copy action, never written back into the editor's contentField, so the earlier reformatting-risk concern doesn't apply here. Added MarkdownSerializerTest.kt (17 tests): exact-string checks per block type plus semantic round-trip (parse(serialize(parse(input))) == parse(input)) including the exact multi-line blockquote example from the earlier richeditor-compose bug report. MarkdownPreview.kt: each block wrapped in BlockWithCopy — code blocks always show the copy icon (GitHub convention), other blocks reveal it on tap and copy directly on long-press with haptic feedback, using LocalClipboardManager (Compose-idiomatic, not raw android.content.ClipboardManager). Verified: compileDebugKotlin, shared/core tests (17/17 new + 30/30 existing parser tests green), full init.sh green.

features.name: Markdown Table Support
features.description: Add GFM-style pipe table support: MdBlock.Table in the AST (shared/core MarkdownParser), MarkdownSerializer round-trip, and a TableRenderer in Android's MarkdownPreview with column alignment and copy-block support.
features.evidence: MarkdownParser.kt: added MdBlock.Table(headers, alignments, rows) with nested ColumnAlignment enum (LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT/NONE). Table detection inserted right after the blank-line check in the parse loop (verified no conflict with hr/atx/blockquote/list-item detectors, which all require leading #, >, digit+./bullet+space, or pure dash/star/underscore runs that a '|'-led table row never matches). parseTable/parseTableRow/parseTableAlignments handle leading/trailing pipe stripping, column padding/truncation to header count, and inline formatting inside cells. MarkdownSerializer.kt: added Table case producing standard GFM output. MarkdownPreview.kt: TableRenderer + TableCell composables (Surface background, bold header row with divider, per-column text alignment, row padding for short rows) wired into BlockRenderer/BlockWithCopy (copy button copies the whole table's markdown). Verified: shared/core tests 40/40 (parser, +10 new) and 21/21 (serializer, +4 new) green; compileDebugKotlin green; full init.sh green; apps:desktop compiles unaffected (doesn't reference MdBlock).

features.name: Android Editor Keyboard-Aware Layout
features.description: Prevent the soft keyboard from covering the text being typed in the Android editor. Switch MainActivity windowSoftInputMode from adjustPan to adjustResize, apply imePadding() to the Scaffold content, and restructure EditorScreen so the content BasicTextField/MarkdownPreview occupies the remaining viewport height (weight(1f)) and the BasicTextField scrolls internally to keep the cursor visible.
features.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml: changed MainActivity windowSoftInputMode from adjustPan to adjustResize. adjustPan only pans the whole window, so Compose never receives IME insets and imePadding() cannot protect the cursor. adjustResize makes WindowInsets.ime report the keyboard height. EditorScreen.kt: removed the outer Column.verticalScroll(scrollState) and the now-unused scrollState. Added Modifier.imePadding() to the Surface that receives Scaffold padding, so the content area shrinks above the keyboard. Wrapped the content region in a Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f)): MarkdownPreview now uses fillMaxSize() + verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()), and the edit BasicTextField uses fillMaxSize() instead of fillMaxWidth(). A bounded-height BasicTextField scrolls internally and automatically keeps the cursor above the keyboard, matching Obsidian/Joplin-style editors. Verified: compileDebugKotlin green; full init.sh green (all tests pass).

features.name: Fix EditorScreen Process-Death Crash
features.description: App crashes when returning from background after Android kills the process: LaunchedEffect(snippetId) calls titleFocusRequester.requestFocus() with hasInitialized restored=true while snippet==null (ViewModel restarted, snippets still loading), so the composable early-returns with the loading spinner and the FocusRequester is not attached to any node -> IllegalStateException: FocusRequester is not initialized. Gate the effect on snippet-loaded state.
features.evidence: Root cause confirmed by code inspection: EditorScreen's initial-load LaunchedEffect was keyed only on snippetId. After process death, rememberSaveable restores hasInitialized=true but the Hilt ViewModel restarts, so filteredSnippets is empty until the DB query emits; snippet==null makes the composable early-return to the loading spinner, leaving titleFocusRequester unattached when requestFocus() fires -> IllegalStateException (FocusRequester is not initialized). Rotation never crashed because the ViewModel survives it. Fix: gate the effect with a boolean snippetLoaded key (LaunchedEffect(snippetId, snippetLoaded)) and return early while the snippet is null; the effect relaunches exactly once when the list loads, after the composition that includes the text fields. Boolean key chosen over the snippet object so auto-save's updated snippet objects (new modifiedAt each save) don't restart the effect and steal focus. Side benefit: also fixes the latent cold-start bug where the old single-key effect returned early forever if snippets hadn't emitted yet, leaving the editor blank. Verified: compileDebugKotlin green; full init.sh green (all tests pass).
